scope: Concurso 36/2012 judicial acts and implementation chain, with emphasis on 2018-2022 transaction identity, asset perimeter, money function, and implementation evidence.
governing_rule: Do not collapse proposal, authorization, competitive threshold, adjudication, deed, registry effect, accounting treatment, or surplus into one event or one figure. Each legal/economic function requires its own source and bridge.

acts.verified_function: Repository reconstruction identifies dation of mortgaged fincas plus a separate EUR 400,000 line for non-mortgaged locales/pools.
acts.not_established: Exact final operative identity of every 2018 instrument and full implementation/accounting treatment.

acts.verified_function: Explains the arithmetic path from EUR 3,079,104.66 toward the EUR 3,182,000 mortgage-liability ceiling and forms part of the competitive-improvement framework.
acts.not_established: That the mortgage ceiling automatically equals the final recognized insolvency credit legally available for set-off.
next_evidence: exact AP source and notification/impugnation trail

acts.verified_function: Publishes quantified conditions for a competing improver, including EUR 13,168,082.02, the separate EUR 400,000 component and EUR 1,145,798.29 Community amount.
acts.not_established: That the combined threshold is CAM's purchase price or a single recognized insolvency credit.

acts.verified_function: A concrete EUR 14.8m competing proposal exists; Auto 164/2021 later records nonappearance and no bond.
acts.not_established: Stamped filing, powers, funds, service, bond ledger or complete appearance record.

acts.verified_function: The Auto records the EUR 14.8m third-party proposal, nonappearance and failure to lodge the bond; it states that, after those events, the competitive licitation could not take place and definitively approves CAM's enumerated proposal. This is kept distinct from the later clarification that a licitation appearance occurred and was not an auction.
acts.not_established: Complete service, third-party authority/funds, bond ledger, appearance record or performance of every approval term.

acts.verified_function: A separate challenge in the approval/licitation sequence was resolved and later clarified.
acts.not_established: Complete performance consequence without the full application, response and service pack.

acts.verified_function: The companion licitation-procedure branch was separately resolved and later clarified.
acts.not_established: Complete performance consequence without the full application, response and service pack.

acts.verified_function: Clarifies one 15 October decision; it does not newly adjudicate assets, calculate surplus or replace the 18 May approval.
acts.not_established: Complete service and then-current finality without the full clarification pack.

acts.verified_function: Clarifies the companion 15 October decision and describes the mechanism as a licitation appearance rather than an auction; it is not the original adjudication.
acts.not_established: Complete service and then-current finality without the full clarification pack.

acts.instrument: Protocol 457 notarial-recital inconsistency — not a judicial order candidate
acts.verified_function: The deed reportedly refers to 26 January on page 10 and 22 January on page 11. The two signed judicial originals are dated 26 January and control their own date and clarification function.
acts.not_established: A separate 22 January judicial order; the deed recital does not create or prove one.
next_evidence: certified deed pagination and exact recitals

acts.verified_function: Primary 76-page deed transfers the described mortgaged fincas to CAM and states EUR 13,168,082.02 as debt serving as consideration for the dation; it also requires communication to the Mercantile Court within five calendar days and articulates cancellation requests.
acts.not_established: That every debt component was legally correct and privileged, that the five-day court communication occurred as required, that registry cancellation matched the request, or that no surplus existed.

acts.verified_function: Current public reconstruction records registration in CAM's favour as a downstream implementation node.
acts.not_established: Exact finca-by-finca scope, cancellation basis, and whether registration proves compliance with every prior judicial/accounting condition.

acts.verified_function: No complete primary accounting bridge has yet been recovered that reconciles credit, interest, EUR 400,000, dation, cash, costs and any surplus/remanente.
acts.not_established: Existence or absence of a surplus/remanente.

cross_cutting_controls.asset_perimeter: LPB estate property must remain separate from Matkator and other third-party property unless a specific legal title and finca-level source proves inclusion or transfer.
cross_cutting_controls.money_function: recognized insolvency credit != mortgage liability != third-party threshold != deed consideration != registry value != surplus
cross_cutting_controls.implementation: An authorization or recital does not prove correct implementation. Court filing, deed, registry, banking and accounting evidence must be separately identified.
cross_cutting_controls.adverse_evidence: Primary adverse holdings and later official outcomes must be retained with equal prominence; absence of a source is not evidence of wrongdoing.
